text:
Three of the 11 searchable contracts mention arbitration: Acme_MSA.pdf (§14.2), Brightline_SOW.docx (§9), and Northwind_NDA.pdf (§11). The other eight don't.

Vendor_Agreement_2019.pdf is a scanned image with no extractable text, so I couldn't search it. Whether it has an arbitration clause is unknown. Running OCR on it would let me check.
